steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.narration: Trendora opens on a live dashboard that reads today's market regime and links straight to the evidence behind it.
steps.point_out: The current regime badge (Risk-on) and the 'See evidence proven in this regime' link just below it.

steps.title: See the benchmark and macro context
steps.narration: The same dashboard carries real index and macro context — the S&P 500, VIX, and a yield-curve proxy — right alongside the regime call.
steps.point_out: The regime-by-phase panel listing each labeled index quote.

steps.title: Browse the stock leaderboard
steps.narration: Every one of the 541 tracked stocks gets a leadership score, and every score is honestly labeled with its evidence status.
steps.point_out: The '541 / 541' coverage count and the 'Not yet proven' badge next to every score.

steps.title: Open a stock's detail page
steps.narration: Drilling into NVDA shows its full profile — sector, score breakdown, and price chart.
steps.point_out: The sector tag and the per-factor score panel.

steps.title: See the full 30-year price history
steps.narration: Switching the chart to full range reveals up to three decades of price history, honestly bounded to each stock's real listing date.
steps.point_out: The bar count jumping from about 1,255 (five-year view) to 3,025 (full history).

steps.title: See the same honesty on another stock
steps.narration: Switching to AAPL shows the identical 'Not yet proven' status — no score is dressed up as proven until it has passed independent testing.
steps.point_out: The 'Not yet proven' badge next to AAPL's score.

steps.title: Audit the evidence ledger
steps.narration: The Evidence ledger lists every tested idea with its real out-of-sample result, wins and losses both — no cherry-picking.
steps.point_out: Each claim card's out-of-sample verdict, control comparison versus SPY, registration date, and forward-walk score-to-date.

steps.title: Trace evidence back to its surface
steps.narration: Every claim links straight back to where it shows up in the product, so the evidence trail never dead-ends.
steps.point_out: Clicking 'Backs: Stocks leaderboard' jumps straight to the leaderboard.

steps.title: See regime-conditioned evidence
steps.narration: Some ideas are only tested within a specific market regime — this card shows how a Risk-on breakout setup fared out of sample.
steps.point_out: The 'Regime: Risk-on' tag on the claim card, and its honest verdict.

expect.text: Out-of-sample edge in the Risk-on regime

steps.title: See evidence across hold horizons
steps.narration: The same setup is retested at different hold lengths too — this one checks a 60-day hold instead of the usual 20 days, and reports the honest result either way.
steps.point_out: The '60-day hold' condition chip next to its own verdict.

steps.title: See combined-factor evidence
steps.narration: Ideas that combine multiple signals — like relative strength crossed with proximity to highs — go through the exact same rigorous, out-of-sample test.
steps.point_out: The composite hypothesis chip and its own honest verdict.

steps.title: Open the Research hub
steps.narration: The Research hub is the gateway to every governance page: pre-registration, the statistical budget, the graveyard of rejected ideas, and the referee's own calibration check.
steps.point_out: The links out to each governance surface.

steps.title: See factors re-certified on 30 years of data
steps.narration: The factor lab confirms every tested signal is re-certified on the full 30-year history — nothing coasts on a stale result.
steps.point_out: The '~30 years of history' disclosure and the per-horizon 'Not yet proven' badges.

steps.title: Drill into a factor's decile grid
steps.narration: Clicking a factor's badge opens its full decile breakdown, showing exactly how each tier of stocks performed going forward.
steps.point_out: The decile grid, ranked from weakest to strongest tier.

steps.title: See the statistical budget before it's spent
steps.narration: Trendora shows exactly how much of its statistical testing budget has been used, so nobody can quietly run endless tests until one passes by chance.
steps.point_out: The next-trial counter and the required significance threshold.

steps.title: Browse the pre-registration registry
steps.narration: Every hypothesis is registered here before it's tested, so nothing can be quietly cherry-picked after the results are in.
steps.point_out: The selector chips, rationale, registration date, and status for each pre-registered idea.

steps.title: Browse the graveyard of rejected ideas
steps.narration: Ideas that failed testing aren't hidden — they're archived here so nobody wastes time re-testing them.
steps.point_out: The list of negative results, each linking back to its registry entry.

steps.title: Trace a rejected idea back to its registration
steps.narration: Clicking a graveyard entry scrolls straight to the matching row in the registry, so the full lineage is one click away.
steps.point_out: The registry row that scrolls into view for the clicked idea.

steps.title: Check the certifier's own calibration
steps.narration: Trendora even audits its own tester — this page runs null-trial and contamination checks to confirm the certifier itself can be trusted.
steps.point_out: The false-pass rate measured on null trials, and a deliberately contaminated factor correctly flagged 'expected: rejected'.

steps.title: See the broad, point-in-time universe
steps.narration: The tracked universe isn't a fixed list — it changes over time, and the Data Manager shows exactly when each stock entered or left.
steps.point_out: The dynamic-universe membership timeline.

steps.title: Run an honest backfill
steps.narration: Kicking off a backfill across the widened, 590-symbol fetch scope completes cleanly and reports exactly what it did.
steps.point_out: The 'Snapshots backfilled' confirmation once the job finishes.

steps.title: See where the index and macro data comes from
steps.narration: Every benchmark and macro series is labeled by its real data vendor, going back to 1996.
steps.point_out: The provenance table listing each index's source and earliest date.

steps.title: Watch for silent data drift
steps.narration: The Data Manager also quietly checks whether freshly-pulled prices agree with the trusted, saved history, and flags it if anything was silently revised.
steps.point_out: The Live-vs-seed drift panel.

steps.title: See one trust strip, everywhere
steps.narration: The same green verdict strip appears on every page, including the watchlist — one shared trust signal instead of a different check on each screen.
steps.point_out: The quiet green 'GO' strip just below the header.
